tax_litigation.status: Pursuant to a departmental GST audit conducted for FY 2021-22, an Order in Form DRC-07 was issued under Section 73(9) of the CGST/MGST Act, 2017. The Company discharged the entire tax liability on 23 December 2025; however, the interest and penalty levied under the order are disputed. The Company’s appeal before the Appellate Authority was admitted on 19 August 2026. The matter is currently pending adjudication, and no appellate order has been received as of the date of this disclosure.
